resources.string: You have seen every lesson. Keep reviewing daily until they are all mastered.

1. Review first: the cards due today (2–4 min).
2. One new lesson: 8 words (5 min).
3. Say every word and example out loud.
4. Write one sentence of your own with a new word.
5. Same time every day. Short and daily beats long and weekly.

string-array.name: learning_tips
string-array.item: Spaced repetition: review just before you would forget. The app schedules each word for you: 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16 days.
Active recall: try to answer before you look. The effort of remembering builds memory far more than rereading.
Little and often: 10–15 minutes every day beats 2 hours on Sunday. Your brain consolidates between sessions.
Chunking: your working memory holds about 7 items, so lessons have 8 words. Finish one, then rest.
Say it out loud: hearing yourself and moving your mouth adds another memory path. Press Listen and imitate the rhythm.
Mnemonics: link the word to a silly image in Spanish. German «aber» (but) → «a ver, pero…». The stranger the image, the better it sticks.
Sentences, not loose words: function words only make sense inside a sentence. Repeat the whole example.
Make it yours: write one sentence about your own life with each new word. Personal memories last longer.
Sleep on it: your brain replays and stores what you learned while you sleep. A short review before bed works very well.
Mix it up: when you review, chapters are mixed. Alternating topics (interleaving) is harder in the moment but sticks better.
Mistakes help: getting it wrong and seeing the right answer at once teaches more than an easy right answer.
Teach it: explain a rule out loud, as if to a friend. Wherever you get stuck is what to review.
Watch for false friends first: the amber «Watch out» notes are the typical mistakes of Spanish speakers.
Move: a short walk or some exercise before studying improves attention and memory.
Don\'t break the chain: even 5 minutes keeps your streak and the habit alive.
Focus blocks: 20 minutes with the phone on silent, then 5 minutes of rest. Multitasking ruins memory.
Cover and say: read the example, cover it, say it from memory, then check.
Real context: change one app to the language, or watch a series with subtitles in it.
